solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Church member entertaining a top boxer perhaps

indicators.note: one piece entertains, i.e. holds, the other within it

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A churchgoer plays host to a leading prizefighter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top boxer perhaps' signals a champion fighter; 'entertaining' has the church member hold A in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A champion is the title holder, and a boxing titleholder is one example of a top fighter.

clue.text: Entertainer's scam involving TV, press, etc.

indicators.note: one piece involves, i.e. surrounds, the other

parts.note: a con is a scam
television and newspapers are the media

explanation.surface: A performer runs a con on the news outlets.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-up or comic performer is one kind of entertainer.

clue.text: In favour of wearing a new pinafore

indicators.note: the outer pieces wear the other, enclosing it like clothing

parts.note: pro means in favour of

explanation.surface: Supporting the wearing of a new pinafore dress.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinafore is a protective garment tied over clothes, the same as a pinny.

clue.text: Broadcast made by expert with very little weight

parts.note: a pro is an expert
a gramme is a tiny unit of weight

explanation.surface: A show made by a specialist on a featherweight topic.
explanation.definitionFit: A television or radio show is a broadcast.

clue.text: Report of district that's more breezy

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the word for district is spoken and taken by its sound

parts.note: an area is a district

explanation.surface: A local news item about a windier neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent AREA and the answer sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of a word describing a place full of fresh air and draughts, a synonym for breezier.

clue.text: Pub that's popular: Nag's Head

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A popular pub called the Nag's Head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nag's Head' is a common British pub name.
explanation.definitionFit: A tavern or public house offering drink and lodging is a pub.

clue.text: Like Ben-Gurion, head off British prime minister

indicators.note: the head, the first letter, comes off the statesman's name

parts.note: Benjamin Disraeli was a Victorian British prime minister

explanation.surface: One statesman resembling another, heading off a British leader.
explanation.definitionFit: David Ben-Gurion was the first prime minister of the state of Israel.

clue.text: Genuine-sounding Scottish dance

indicators.note: sounding marks the word for genuine as heard rather than spelt

parts.note: real means genuine

explanation.surface: An authentic-seeming Highland dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively folk dance for couples, typical of Scotland.

clue.text: Rich person's factory, one on Yorkshire river

parts.note: a mill is a factory
I is the Roman numeral one
the Aire is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A wealthy mill-owner's works stand beside a northern river.
explanation.walkthrough: Yorkshire is a county in northern England; the Aire flows through Leeds.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone whose wealth runs to seven figures is a very wealthy individual.

clue.text: Italian physicist's brief month on island?

indicators.note: made brief, so the word for the month loses its last letter

parts.note: March is a month

explanation.surface: A short spring break on an island for an Italian scientist.
explanation.definitionFit: Guglielmo Marconi was the Italian physicist who pioneered radio transmission.

clue.text: Old railwaymen given points to look after

parts.note: NUR, the National Union of Railwaymen, a former British trade union
S and E, two compass points

explanation.surface: Retired rail workers are given points to care for.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUR was the British rail workers' union until 1990.
explanation.definitionFit: To tend someone who is ill or weak is to care for, or look after, them.

clue.text: Uproar in first half of meal

indicators.note: only the opening half of the six-letter word for the meal is kept

parts.note: dinner is a meal

explanation.surface: A disturbance breaks out partway through a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud continuous noise or clamour is a synonym for uproar.

clue.text: Her deli's output is greatly enjoyed

indicators.note: output is what is produced from the letters, i.e. they are reworked into something new

explanation.surface: The produce from her delicatessen goes down very well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'output' signals rearranging the letters of HER DELIS.
explanation.definitionFit: To savour something with keen pleasure is a synonym of to enjoy it greatly.

clue.text: Unoriginal friend's impasse in chess

parts.note: stale means unoriginal or hackneyed
mate is a friend; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: A dull pal reaches a deadlock over the board.
explanation.definitionFit: A position in which the player to move has no legal move, so the game is drawn.

clue.text: Rabble-rouser finally appearing at a riot, unhappily

indicators.note: unhappily signals these letters are disturbed into a new order
finally points to the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A troublemaker finally turns up at a riot, causing misery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unhappily' rearranges G (from 'finally appearing') with AT A RIOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabble-rouser stirs up crowds, which is what a political troublemaker does.

clue.text: Obliging, acting as landlord?

definitions.meaning: willing to help or fit in with others
providing lodging or rooms for tenants, as a landlord does

explanation.definitionFit: Helpful people go out of their way, and a landlord houses tenants: both are senses of the answer.

clue.text: French painter left to support tea girl

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting letter goes below the others

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
gal is a girl

explanation.surface: A painter quits work to hold up a tea lady.
explanation.walkthrough: Marc Chagall worked in France, so 'French painter' is fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Marc Chagall was the Russian-born French modernist painter.

clue.text: Tear delicate fabric, meeting cost

parts.note: lace is a delicate openwork fabric
a rate is a charge or cost

explanation.surface: Ripping fine material, then facing the bill for it.
explanation.definitionFit: To rip or gash flesh or cloth is to tear it.

clue.text: Bachelor originally attending tennis club

indicators.note: the original, i.e. first, letters of the following two words are taken

explanation.surface: A single man first turns up at a tennis club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tennis club' looks like one unit, but 'tennis' only gives its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket or baseball implement for striking the ball is a kind of club.

clue.text: Old crooner accepts pound for flashy jewellery

indicators.note: the singer's name takes in, i.e. holds, the other piece

parts.note: Bing Crosby, the mid-century crooner
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A veteran singer takes money for showy gems.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for ostentatious, showy jewellery and accessories.

clue.text: A good press chief much advanced in years

parts.note: ED, short for editor, the head of a newspaper

explanation.surface: A decent newspaper boss well on in years.
explanation.definitionFit: Old or elderly, being far along in life.

clue.text: Old English cricketer's elegance of manner

definitions.meaning: W.G. ..., the famous Victorian England cricketer
poise and refinement in movement or behaviour

explanation.definitionFit: W.G. Grace was England's great Victorian batsman, and the same word means poise or refinement.

clue.text: Tailed amphibian familiar at first in sci-fi film

indicators.note: the first letter goes in the film title

parts.note: E.T. is Spielberg's science fiction film

indicators.note: at first takes only the first letter of familiar

explanation.surface: A familiar newt-like creature appears in a science fiction film.
explanation.definitionFit: A newt, especially a young one, is a small tailed amphibian.

clue.text: One with no illusions about a register

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a list is a register

explanation.surface: A clear-eyed person's view of an official record.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sees things as they really are and harbours no illusions is a pragmatist.

clue.text: Remove obstruction in river

indicators.note: the obstruction word sits in the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a British river
a let is an obstruction, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: Clearing a blockage from a waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: LET as obstruction survives in the legal phrase 'without let or hindrance'.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase or strike out text is to remove it.

clue.text: Unusually regal composer

indicators.note: used unusually, so the letters of regal appear in a different order

explanation.surface: A composer with an unexpectedly royal air.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar was the English composer of the Enigma Variations.
